top_signals.title: Singapore Bank Shares Tumble as Yield Surge Threatens Earnings
top_signals.summary: A selloff in Singapore bank shares deepened after JPMorgan Chase & Co. warned that surging long bond yields will hurt third-quarter earnings for Southeast Asian lenders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
